$comment: The know-how each Krizaka product proves — the provable sentences of krizaka.com (messages site.products.knowhow.*). Structure of the products (name, url, status, repo) comes from @krizaka/ui/sites; this file only holds words. A product listed here but not yet in the published @krizaka/ui/sites carries a `fallback` until the package knows it. Products in `paused` are left out of the profile even while the package still lists them (decision 2026-10-25: their repositories turn private).

orazaka.proof: Every request crosses a deterministic pipeline to the best local model: your documents, your models, your network — nothing leaves.

yomizaka.proof: A lease checked rule by rule against the law in force on a date, a PDF examined for signs of editing: every finding quotes its passage, every check is a traced Orazaka run.

akinaza.proof: Bookings, bilingual invoices with GST and QST to the cent and a ledger the database keeps balanced, for independent Québec shops; the GST/QST return is prepared, and the merchant files it.
